public_comments.text: Yes. I think that, in particular, related to water, the technology exists in which large volumes of water do not need to be used. It's a financial decision. Do not give in. It's really that simple. I mean, we, I have, I am for a few more days still the mayor of the city of Lancaster and have been advocating a lot around water, water quality issues, storm water, all of that facets of water. To yield to development that consumes the volume of water that is necessary to cool under the previous iteration of data centers to me is unfathomable, and it is not correct. And I believe that elected leaders across Pennsylvania who are contemplating this, there is technology, and Carissa has shown us that that is true, to cool these facilities using a closed-loop system. And that technology exists, and every community should be demanding its use to these two properties.
